Chat message

Source: R/tier1-message.R
shad_message.Rd

A full conversation row: avatar, header (sender + meta), a shad_bubble() surface, and a footer (status, actions). Part of the chat/AI kit. Group consecutive same-sender rows with shad_message_group().

Usage

shad_message(
  ...,
  align = c("start", "end"),
  avatar = NULL,
  sender = NULL,
  meta = NULL,
  footer = NULL,
  state = NULL,
  bubble_variant = "muted",
  class = NULL
)

shad_message_group(..., class = NULL)

Arguments

...

The message body — placed inside the bubble content. For state = "typing" the body is replaced by an animated typing indicator.

align

"start" (received) or "end" (sent).

avatar

Optional avatar: a tag (e.g. shad_avatar() or an <img>) or a short string of initials.

sender

Optional sender name (shown in the header).

meta

Optional header meta (time, badge) shown after the sender.

footer

Optional footer content (status text, a retry button). Pair with state = "in-progress" to show a spinner.

state

Optional "typing", "in-progress", or "failed".

bubble_variant

shad_bubble() variant for the surface (default "muted").

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A message tag.

See also

Other shadshiny chat components: shad_attachment(), shad_bubble(), shad_marker(), shad_message_spinner()

Examples

shad_message("Did the model finish training?", sender = "Ada K.",
             meta = "9:41 AM", avatar = "AK")
#> <div class="shad-message shad-message--start">
#>   <div class="shad-message__avatar" aria-hidden="true">AK</div>
#>   <div class="shad-message__content">
#>     <div class="shad-message__header">
#>       <span class="shad-message__sender">Ada K.</span>
#>       <span>9:41 AM</span>
#>     </div>
#>     <div class="shad-bubble shad-bubble--muted">
#>       <div class="shad-bubble__content">Did the model finish training?</div>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
shad_message(align = "end", avatar = "ME", state = "typing")
#> <div class="shad-message shad-message--end" data-state="typing">
#>   <div class="shad-message__avatar" aria-hidden="true">ME</div>
#>   <div class="shad-message__content">
#>     <div class="shad-bubble shad-bubble--muted" role="status">
#>       <div class="shad-bubble__content">
#>         <span class="shad-message__typing" aria-hidden="true">
#>           <span></span>
#>           <span></span>
#>           <span></span>
#>         </span>
#>       </div>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
